description: The claims babysitter's claim half: bucket every claim in your my-claims registry (~/.greenlight/my-claims.json) by its live Claim Protocol status — linked, linked-dead, healthy-active, heartbeat-due, expiring, unlinked-stale, queue-lost — and retire claims that completed or released. Pair with babysit_prs for the full portfolio picture.

claims_registry_path.description: Override path for the my-claims registry. Defaults to ~/.greenlight/my-claims.json.

name: my_claims
